page_title: BAR 3-5 VIL | Barcelona v Villarreal 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' Jose Luis Munuera Montero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+12' 3 - 5 Goal! A terrific long pass from Goncalo Guedes picks out an unmarked Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 3:5.
90+9' 3 - 4 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 3:4.
90+9' A pass lands at the feet of Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
90+8' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+4' Yellow card. Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90+2' The Barcelona players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero. NO PENALTY!
90+1' Celebrations by Barcelona are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Handball by Santi Comesana (Villarreal). The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Barcelona.
89' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
89' A yellow card is awarded to Ronald Araujo (Barcelona).
89' Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
88' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Barcelona earn a corner.
88' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner kick, but Filip Jorgensen reads it well and stops the effort.
86' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ferran Torres, but Filip Jorgensen displays great awareness to stop him.
84' 3 - 3 Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
83' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Filip Jorgensen.
83' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) works the corner short.

82' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Filip Jorgensen makes a great save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
78' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) replaces Kiko.
78' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Gerard Moreno is replaced by Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal).
77' Substitution. Robert Lewandowski will be replaced by Vitor Roque (Barcelona).
77' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) meets a cross inside the box, but Inaki Pena wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
71' 3 - 2 Eric Bailly (Villarreal) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
71' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Alberto Moreno will be replaced by Aissa Mandi (Villarreal).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Alex Baena cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Xavi is stunned as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
68' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets booked for the first time in this match.
68' 2 - 2 Goal! Pedri (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:2.
68' Eric Bailly (Villarreal) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
67' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

64' What a huge chance for Ferran Torres (Barcelona). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
63' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
60' 1 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski pulls the ball back for Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
59' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Filip Jorgensen.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) will replace Joao Felix.
58' Problems for Marcelino as Ilias Akhomach is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) replaces him.
57' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' 0 - 2 Filip Jorgensen passes to Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
53' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
52' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
52' The ball is cleared after Joao Felix (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
50' The attendance for today's match is 46269.

50' Joao Cancelo smashes in a cross, but Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.

49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ronald Araujo, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
48' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.

48' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' Half-time substitution. Xavi decided to make a change. Hector Fort (Barcelona) is replaced by Joao Cancelo.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) is replaced by Pau Cubarsi.
46' Xavi makes a switch. Pedri is coming on in place of Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
45+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) prepares to take a corner kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' Joao Felix (Barcelona) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
45' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
45' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows the whistle, Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona in a dangerous position.
41' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexander Sorloth provides Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 0:1.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
36' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
33' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
29' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
28' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
24' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
22' Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:1.
18' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero has finally had enough of Marcelino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
16' Alex Baena (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
16' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

15' Joao Felix (Barcelona) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Filip Jorgensen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
12' PENALTY APPEAL after Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

8' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the top left corner, but Filip Jorgensen has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
8' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
7' Barcelona keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
5' The corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared away by the defence.

4' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
3' Alex Baena (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
1' The game is interrupted as Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is flagged offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Villarreal will kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero is introduced as the referee for today's match.
